The '''CED8089Y Shields''' were a model of [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] used to create a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]]. It was created by [[Chempat Engineered Defenses]]. The CED8089Y Shields were intended for use on [[Podracer/Legends|Podracers]].<ref name="EV" />
